SANCTIONS: The Council renewed the 2293 measures until 1 July 2024 and reiterated that the 1807 measures apply to nongovernmental entities and individuals operating in the DRC. [SANCTIONS]
EXPERTS: Experts' mandate runs to 1 August 2024, with review and possible extension action by 1 July 2024. Council reports are due 30 December 2023 and 15 June 2024; Committee updates are monthly except in those months. [EXPERTS]
RUSSIA: Russia voted in favour, supported adjusting or lifting unsuitable sanctions, and opposed illegitimate unilateral measures. It welcomed the Council's December 2022 removal of the DRC notification requirement. [RUSSIA]
DRC: The DRC welcomed the targeting of nongovernmental entities and individuals, assured cooperation with the Experts, called for objectivity and reported timely submission of its confidential stock-management report. [DRC]
overlap: Both welcomed the renewal. Russia voted in favour; the DRC spoke after the vote as the affected state. [VOTE, RUSSIA, DRC]
